description: Local evals for this repo's Claude Code rules and skills

scripts.promptfoo: PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_UPDATE=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_SHARING=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_REMOTE_GENERATION=1 PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR=./.promptfoo promptfoo
scripts.eval-omp: EVAL_HARNESS=omp npm run promptfoo -- eval --no-cache --no-share -c harness.js
scripts.eval-pi: EVAL_HARNESS=pi npm run promptfoo -- eval --no-cache --no-share -c harness.js
scripts.clean: if pgrep -f "promptfoo[ ]eval" >/dev/null; then echo "An eval is still running; let it finish first." >&2; exit 1; fi; rm -rf .promptfoo "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/csharp-skills-evals" "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}"/projects/*csharp-skills-evals* && echo "Removed all eval results, run directories and kept sessions."
